_about: HUMBABA'S FACE IS WATCHING v1 (pool lane S4, HumbabaWatch.cs, UNPROVEN IN UNITY). enabled false = nothing runs. eyes.faces[].eyes[] = iris socket positions as FRACTIONS of the prop's own renderer bounds (u across, v up, w depth of the eye surface, all measured on the glTF mesh in headless Blender: eyes centred at x -0.017 / +0.050, y 0.379 / 0.380 up of 0.737, surface depth 0.131 / 0.140 of a 0.964 deep box; the face is not centred on the trunk, its centre line is x +0.017). flipX true because glTFast mirrors X on import (if the proof shot shows the irises on the wrong sockets, flip this one value). irisWidthFrac = iris width as a fraction of the box width; maxOffsetFrac = largest offset inside the socket as a fraction of the iris width; maxYawDeg / maxPitchDeg = gaze angle that gives the full offset; standoffFrac = how far in front of the eye surface the quad sits (fraction of box depth). eyes.followSpeed 1/s exponential. heavy: a Hit event by the player on bossId with the heavy flag and at least minDamage health lost. groan: an EXISTING cue (effort_voice) pitched down = placeholder (missing: a real wood groan, see READY.md). branch: sourceProp = an EXISTING scene prop that is cloned (z5_root_log_NW, fallen_pillar_3), scaled to targetLengthM, colliders stripped; telegraphS = ground mark time before the landing; radiusM = mark size, damageRadiusM = hurt radius (Joan only unless hurtBoss); dodge i-frames avoid it; nonLethal keeps Joan at 1 HP minimum; maxPerFight and cooldownS cap it (and the shared SurpriseGate allows one surprise per zone visit when useGate is true). proof.forceAtS = harness only (-s4:1): seconds after boss and Joan exist until a scripted heavy hit.
